data.title: 空门苍 · 藏书古阁的眠猫蜷卧
data.action: 蜷缩在旧神社藏书库的木地板毛毯上，双手搂着厚厚的鸟白岛民间传说古籍，淡紫双马尾散开，在月光下睡眼惺忪地揉着眼睛向你打哈欠。
data.location: 鸟白岛古老神社后山藏书阁，木质地板上整齐叠放着岛民历史卷宗与狐狸面具
data.timeOfDay: 夏日午夜读灵异故事的贪睡时刻
data.lighting: 透过纸拉门的皎洁银月光直直照在地板上，与旧油灯的暖微红光形成梦幻映照
data.mood: 随性慵懒的岛屿少女日常，带着灵异传说的神秘与邻家女孩的亲昵
data.description: 鸟白岛古老神社后山藏书阁，木质地板上整齐叠放着岛民历史卷宗与狐狸面具。蜷缩在旧神社藏书库的木地板毛毯上，双手搂着厚厚的鸟白岛民间传说古籍，淡紫双马尾散开，在月光下睡眼惺忪地揉着眼睛向你打哈欠。 她微微抬眸轻语——“呼啊……羽未的故事还没看完呢……鹰原，你来啦……好困，过来给苍当枕头嘛……”
data.promptProse: Curled atop a folded blanket on the polished wooden floor of Torishirojima's hillside shrine archive at midnight, Ao wears a breathable pale-lavender polka-dot cotton camisole and soft gathered tap shorts. Hugging her knees beside stacked island folklore scrolls and a hanging fox mask, she blinks drowsily through a sleepy yawn toward the viewer. Silvery moonlight through the sliding paper doors blends with the warm red-amber flicker of an old oil lantern.
data.animaCaption: Curled barefoot on the wooden shrine archive floor in her lavender polka-dot cotton camisole and tap shorts, Ao hugs her knees beside stacked folklore scrolls and yawns sleepily. Silver moonlight and warm lantern glow meet across the quiet room.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a pale lavender white-polka-dot cotton camisole paired with soft gathered bubble tap shorts, barefoot on the wooden floor.
